projects.name: Greater Atlanta metro 873-acre parcel
projects.quote: An 873-acre parcel in the greater Atlanta metro area for $95 million.

projects.name: Portland metro 30-acre parcel
projects.quote: A 30-acre parcel of land in the Portland metro area for $50 million that ● is expected to support 160 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: Portland metro land assemblage
projects.quote: This parcel is near another assemblage of land announced last quarter that is expected to support up to 85 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: Telepoint
projects.quote: Telepoint, a leading data center and interconnection provider based in ● Sofia, Bulgaria, for €66.5 million or $76.6 million, adding the market’s leading connectivity hub to PlatformDIGITAL.

projects.name: TelcoHub 1
projects.quote: Also previously disclosed, during the first quarter of 2026 Digital Realty entered into an agreement, to acquire TelcoHub 1, an operational 1.5-megawatt data center that is one of Malaysia's leading connectivity hubs, and an adjacent land parcel that can support the development of up to 14 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: TelcoHub 1 adjacent land parcel

projects.name: Cyberjaya, Malaysia data center development
projects.quote: Subsequent to quarter end, Digital Realty acquired a 15-megawatt data center development in Cyberjaya, Malaysia, located near TelcoHub 1, for approximately $117 million.
